letter_deductions.deduction: Reduce operative package to nonsurgical package
letter_deductions.why: The recreational badminton incident record describes a sudden Achilles rupture. Operative notes confirm surgical tendon repair. The fictional network tariff in force on admission lists Rs 140,000 for operative repair and Rs 60,000 for nonsurgical management. This claim satisfies the operative row.
